name: Prunus Vase (Meiping) with Blossoming Lotus
material: Porcelain with polychrome glazes, Fahua ware
dimensions: Diameter: 19 cm (7 1/2 in.); Overall: 37.5 cm (14 3/4 in.)
summary: According to 11th-century poet Zhou Dunyi, “all people like peonies, but I alone like the lotus because it emerges from the mud unstained.” The lotus is a symbol of purity and popular among Chinese literati and in Buddhism.
